summary: Texas Pacific Land Corp (TPL) filed an 8-K disclosing a Board Representative Agreement with Horizon Kinetics, appointing Peter Doyle (Horizon Kinetics co-CEO) to the board effective May 5, 2026. Doyle will stand for election at the 2026 annual meeting and serve on the strategic acquisitions committee. This agreement follows Horizon's likely activist or investment stake, securing board representation. No financial terms, price, or premium are stated. The appointment is immediate with a nomination commitment. Watch for further strategic actions or shareholder engagement from Horizon, given its active role in TPL's governance.
